D25·ebaq — 2026-10-10
chose: 2.4's "affected-tests verify per merge, full suite per batch" clause is carried by 2.6. In 2.4 a merge re-verifies through the one acceptance gate (the task's own verify command, else the run's, plus the decision checks that apply to its files), so when 2.6 tiers that gate (typecheck plus covering tests per task, full gate per phase and run end, bisect to pin a failure) every merge re-verify is tiered with it.
over: Building a per-merge "affected" command and a per-batch full-suite run inside 2.4
because: The operator's later ruling ("its better to check at last right? yes") created 2.6, which specifies the same split with the piece 2.4 lacks: bisecting a full-gate failure to its task. A batch suite built here could fail with no task to reopen, and two verify tiers built in two tasks would drift. The clause was the plan's reading at creation, not the operator's words.
